answer_1.quote: Our method yields a diverse set of responses for each case... We propose a framework, ETHOSAGENTS, that leverages structured reasoning for automatically generating diverse personas tailored to each scenario.
answer_1.outputs: pluralistic health-related responses (multiple ethical perspectives per scenario)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method for each pluralistic alignment mode through two metrics. We use an NLI model to calculate Overton coverage... In Distributional, we measure similarity between the gold truth and actual distributions using the Jensen-Shannon (JS) distance. For Steerable we report accuracy.

answer_3.quote: Responses are also evaluated using GPT-4o to simulate expert judgment and provide a scalable second opinion.

answer_4.quote: We conduct a pairwise comparison study... Annotators are asked to select the response that better reflects a pluralistic ethical perspective. "Which response better reflects pluralistic values, or is it a tie?"
answer_4.guideline: Annotators choose which of two responses better reflects pluralistic values (or tie).
